### en

- [Why n8n 3.0 still does not replace LangGraph for AI agent engineering](https://antoniovfranco.com/articles/why-n8n-3-0-still-does-not-replace-langgraph/en/): What changes in n8n 3.0, and why I still choose LangGraph when agents need state control and recovery after failures.
- [Can a smaller agent do the work of a larger model? The new economics of agentic fine-tuning](https://antoniovfranco.com/articles/smaller-agent-larger-model-agentic-fine-tuning/en/): When can a smaller agent complete a business task more economically than a larger general-purpose model?
